title: Project: a real website
goal: Combine structure, design and responsiveness into a small site.
explanation: Build a portfolio or a fictional local-business site with a clear audience and primary action. Write the content before polishing the visual details.
Include an introduction, services or projects, and contact information. Use semantic HTML, reusable styles, readable typography and a responsive layout.
Test keyboard navigation, narrow screens, links and missing content. Keep the project small enough to finish, then record improvements for a later iteration.

Project brief
Audience: local businesses
Goal: request a consultation
Pages: Home, Work, Contact
Success: visitors understand the offer and can make contact
Checks: keyboard, mobile layout, real links, readable contrast
exercise: Build the three-page site and write a short explanation of three design decisions.
hint: Choose one audience and one primary action instead of adding every possible feature.

quiz.question: Which is a useful acceptance criterion?
options: A keyboard user can reach and activate the contact link
It has as many animations as possible
quiz.explanation: A concrete observable criterion can be tested.
